content.short: TON API provides REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, liteservers, and developer tools for building TON apps.
content.description: TON API is a developer infrastructure service for The Open Network. Its site describes REST API access, webhooks, SDKs, liteservers, request examples, and tooling for teams building dapps or blockchain products on TON. It belongs in the registry as backend infrastructure for developers rather than a consumer-facing wallet. Build TON dApps with TONAPI Services: REST API, Webhooks, SDK, Liteservers and other tools. The product surface includes powerful saas service, key features, request examples, and ton console.
